ruleReferences.usedFor: Official Counterattack Grouping FAQ: each in-play Wishiwashi triggers; separate attacks each trigger.

Official retaliation FAQ: resolve attack healing/return text first; attack source switched to Bench still receives counters, but departed attacker does not; retaliation can resolve before the damaged source is Knocked Out.

evidence.name: Counterattack Grouping
evidence.textEn: If your Wishiwashi or Wishiwashi {ex} is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if your Pokémon is Knocked Out), place 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.
evidence.textZh: 只要这只宝可梦在场上，自己战斗场上的「弱丁鱼（包含『宝可梦{ex}』）」受到对手宝可梦的招式的伤害时[即使自己的宝可梦因此昏厥]，就给使用了招式的宝可梦身上放置3个伤害指示物。
